cases.name: Essie Louise Buck
cases.narrative: He picked her up in a San Diego tavern. He left her  body in his trunk overnight, then discarded her nude body the next day, which was his 33rd birthday.  Her body in was found by a child in a Poway field. The coroner did not determine a cause of Buck’s death, although she was found by officials to have had an abnormally high level of alcohol in her blood. “In none of the cases could we link Cole to these deaths,” Robinson said. “We ruled out murder in each of the cases and did not change our determination after our interviews (with Cole) in Dallas.” https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1985-11-28-me-9130-story.html
